policy: An actively used compatibility API is not annotated deprecated until production callers have migrated. Every entry has an owner, replacement, and objective removal criterion.

lib/domain/entities/task.dart.removalCriteria: Remove after all engine, state, data, and presentation callers use TaskEntity without relying on the legacy non-null estimatedDuration contract.

lib/domain/entities/time_block.dart.removalCriteria: Remove after planning and Nexus callers use CalendarEntryEntity without relying on the completed or non-null taskId compatibility accessors.

lib/engine/si/si_ai_service.dart.removalCriteria: Remove after agent callers consume SIEngineService directly and the public SI surface no longer exports SIAIService.

lib/engine/si/synthetic_intelligence_eng.removalCriteria: Remove after the cognitive input adapter and runtime-control tests are represented directly on SIEngineService.
